result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection equipped with marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and traffic signals. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and parked vehicles near the corners may impact visibility and safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the intersection can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, particularly children or those using mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street approaching the intersection.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: The main roadway crossing at the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install visible pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide better information to people crossing the street.
